title.zh: 服务器硬盘为什么用 SAS

desc.zh: 同样的盘片，SATA 版和 SAS 版装进机房，为什么服务器偏偏要 SAS？七个可以拖动的模型：一条 SCSI 命令的字节、一次读要开几次连接、两条路径的可用度、扩展器后面的扇出、宽端口的四条道、T10 PI 的 8 字节校验、24G 的纠错码。
desc.en: The same platters ship as SATA and as SAS drives; why do servers insist on SAS? Seven models you can drag: the bytes of one SCSI command, how many connections one read opens, the availability of two paths, fan-out behind an expander, the four lanes of a wide port, the 8-byte T10 PI check, and the error-correcting code of 24G.

title.zh: SAS 的分层：SCSI 命令、SSP/STP/SMP 与物理层
title.en: SAS Layers: SCSI Commands, SSP/STP/SMP and the Phy

desc.zh: SAS 自己只管线、帧和连接，命令来自 T10 的 SCSI 命令集；SSP 运 SCSI，STP 运 SATA，SMP 管扩展器。
desc.en: SAS defines the wire, frames and connections; the commands come from T10's SCSI set. SSP carries SCSI, STP tunnels SATA, SMP manages expanders.

zh: SAS 和 SCSI 的关系

title.zh: SCSI 命令块 CDB、LUN 与标签队列
title.en: The SCSI CDB, LUNs and Tagged Queuing

desc.zh: READ(6)/(10)/(16) 的地址字段只有 21/32/64 位，决定了能寻址多大的盘；同一个 CDB 可以装进 SAS、USB、iSCSI 或光纤通道。
desc.en: The address field of READ(6)/(10)/(16) is 21, 32 or 64 bits wide, which sets how large a drive it can address; the same CDB rides inside SAS, USB, iSCSI or Fibre Channel.

title.zh: SSP 的一次读：帧和两次连接
title.en: One SSP Read: Frames and Two Connections

desc.zh: 一次 4 KiB 读要发命令帧、数据帧和响应帧，还要开关两次连接；小块读的线路效率因此明显低于大块读。
desc.en: A 4 KiB read sends a command frame, data frames and a response frame and opens two connections, so small reads use the link far less efficiently than large ones.

title.zh: 双端口与多路径的可用度算术
title.en: Availability Arithmetic of Dual Port and Multipath

desc.zh: 两条独立路径的不可用度相乘；双路径之后，剩下的停机主要来自盘本身和切换时间。
desc.en: Two independent paths multiply their unavailabilities; once there are two, the remaining downtime comes mostly from the drive itself and the failover pause.

zh: 几个九 可用性怎么算

title.zh: SAS 扩展器、地址与分区

desc.zh: 扩展器让几十上百块盘共享几条上行道；顺序读时机械盘很快把上行道占满，随机读时几乎不占。
desc.en: An expander lets dozens or hundreds of drives share a few uplink lanes; sequential hard-disk reads soon fill the uplink, random reads barely use it.

title.zh: 宽端口：四条道不能合成一条
title.en: Wide Ports: Four Lanes Are Not One Fast Lane

desc.zh: 一个连接只占宽端口的一条道，所以一块盘最多用一条道的带宽，四条道要四块盘才能用满。
desc.en: Each connection holds one lane of a wide port, so one drive gets at most one lane, and it takes four drives to fill four lanes.

title.zh: STP：SAS 口为什么认 SATA 盘
title.en: STP: Why a SAS Port Accepts a SATA Drive

desc.zh: SAS 控制器会说 SATA（STP），SAS 插座也接受 SATA 盘的插头；反过来 SATA 主机不会说 SCSI，插头也被挡住。
desc.en: A SAS controller speaks SATA through STP and a SAS receptacle accepts a SATA plug; a SATA host does not speak SCSI and the plug is keyed out.

zh: SAS 控制器怎么认 SATA 硬盘
SAS 硬盘接口为什么多一块
SATA 硬盘接 SAS 背板
en: why SAS connector has extra pins

title.zh: T10 PI：每个块多 8 字节
title.en: T10 PI: Eight More Bytes per Block

desc.zh: 保护信息由 CRC-16 守卫、应用标签和引用标签组成，从主机一路带到盘上，能抓住内存里翻转的位和写错地址的块。
desc.en: Protection information is a CRC-16 guard, an application tag and a reference tag, carried from host to platter; it catches bits flipped in memory and blocks written to the wrong address.

title.zh: 24G SAS 的 128b/150b 编码与纠错

desc.zh: SAS-4 用 RS(30,26) 纠错把每码字两个坏符号修回来；连串的突发错误会压垮它，交织能救回来。
desc.en: SAS-4 uses an RS(30,26) code that repairs two bad symbols per codeword; burst errors overwhelm it and interleaving brings it back.

title.zh: SAS 的前沿（截至 2026 年 11 月）

desc.zh: SAS-5 草案在 INCITS 审批，24G+ 仍是 22.5 Gbaud；机械盘大多还走 SAS 或 SATA。
desc.en: The SAS-5 draft is in INCITS approval and 24G+ stays at 22.5 Gbaud; most hard drives still ship on SAS or SATA.

NVMe 会取代 SAS 吗

title.zh: 看到 SAS 时问三件事
title.en: Three Questions When You See SAS

desc.zh: 是哪一代、几条道、盘有没有双端口和 PI。
desc.en: Which generation, how many lanes, and does the drive have two ports and PI?
